AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Child of nomads
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent all {PAWN_gender ? his : her} childhood hiking and wandering with {PAWN_gender ? his : her} nomadic people.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Rogue
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: As a child, [PAWN_nameDef] engaged in robbery, taking food from the weak.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Robber
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s parents left{PAWN_gender ? him : her}him on a camping trip, so {PAWN_gender ? he : she} starts robbing neighbors for food.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Maid
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] didn't like war, so {PAWN_gender ? he : she} always stayed in camp to work.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Marching musician
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] always had a gift for music. [PAWN_nameDef] will often perform during the march.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Village child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] all childhood lives in a settled village, far from hostilities.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Apostate
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] leaves {PAWN_gender ? his : her} people, not accepting the foundations of society.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Scout
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was often sent out on scouts, because {PAWN_gender ? he : she} can sneak up on anyone.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Messenger
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] runs fast, which was the deciding factor in the appointment of {PAWN_gender ? him : her} a messenger to deliver orders.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Young hunter
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_gender ? He : She} has lived with the nomadic group all {PAWN_gender ? his : her} childhood, helping {PAWN_gender ? his : her} as much as she can.
